questions.question: A distracted driver usually:

options.text: Is aware of what is happening around them.
Is a good person to follow.

questions.explanation: Distracted driving slows your perception and delays your decisions. This can lead to mistakes. Avoid distracted drivers when you can.

questions.question: Which activity does NOT cause a distraction while driving?
questions.explanation: Anything that takes your attention away from driving is dangerous. This includes eating, drinking, smoking, and adjusting the radio or climate controls. Checking mirrors is part of safe driving.

questions.question: When pulled over on the side of the road, a driver should:

options.text: Keep the driver's side door open.

questions.explanation: Always use your four-way emergency flashers when stopped on the side of the road. This is especially important at night.

questions.question: How can you tell if a vehicle has an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS)?

options.text: A sticker on the control panel
A yellow light on the instrument panel
The letters "ABS" on the brake pedal
A metal plate on the inside of the driver's side door

questions.correctAnswerText: A yellow light on the instrument panel
questions.explanation: Look for a yellow ABS light on your instrument panel. This light shows your vehicle has an Anti-Lock Braking System.

questions.question: When should you adjust your mirrors?

options.text: When stopped at a traffic signal

questions.explanation: Check and adjust your mirrors before you start driving. If you have a trailer, make sure it is straight when adjusting mirrors.

questions.question: When making a left turn, you should start turning:

options.text: Before reaching the center of the intersection
At or after reaching the center of the intersection
After your rear wheels have passed the center of the intersection

questions.correctAnswerText: At or after reaching the center of the intersection
questions.explanation: Wait until you reach the center of the intersection before turning left. If you turn too early, the left side of your vehicle could hit another car.

questions.question: What removes alcohol from your bloodstream?
questions.explanation: Your body removes alcohol at a fixed rate. Coffee and exercise cannot speed this up. Only time will sober you up.

questions.question: After two violations for using a hand-held mobile phone while driving, what happens to your CDL?

options.text: You must cancel your mobile phone service.
You must drive 10 mph under the speed limit for a period of time.

questions.explanation: Two convictions for hand-held mobile phone use while driving will disqualify your CDL. More violations lead to harsher penalties.

questions.question: If the coolant temperature gauge goes above the safe level, you should:

options.text: Pull over and check what is wrong.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull over and check what is wrong.
questions.explanation: Stop driving immediately if the coolant temperature gauge is too high. Your engine could fail or catch fire. Find out what the problem is.

questions.question: When entering fog, you should:

options.text: Turn on your high beam headlights.
Turn up the volume of the radio.

questions.explanation: Avoid driving in fog if possible. If you must drive through fog, slow down before you reach it.

questions.question: Why are roads most slippery right after rain starts?

options.text: Water mixes with oil and grease on the road.
Gravel gets washed to the middle of the lane.
Some tires are not designed for rain.

questions.correctAnswerText: Water mixes with oil and grease on the road.
questions.explanation: When rain first starts, water mixes with oil on the road. This creates a very slippery surface.

questions.question: According to the National Sleep Foundation, about ____ of people have driven while sleepy.
questions.explanation: The National Sleep Foundation found that 60 percent of Americans have driven while feeling sleepy. Also, 36 percent have actually fallen asleep while driving.

questions.question: At a railroad crossing during the driving test, you should:

options.text: Pass another vehicle on the tracks if it is going too slow.
Get out of the vehicle to check for a train.
Not change gears while your vehicle is on the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not change gears while your vehicle is on the tracks.
questions.explanation: Do not stop, change gears, pass another vehicle, or change lanes while any part of your vehicle is on railroad tracks.

questions.question: When you start an engine, what should happen?

options.text: Warning lights should turn on, then turn off quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warning lights should turn on, then turn off quickly.
questions.explanation: Warning lights and buzzers should turn off after a few seconds. If they stay on, something may be wrong with the vehicle.

questions.question: A vehicle inspection is required:
questions.explanation: Federal and state laws require vehicle inspections before every trip.

questions.question: What can rust around wheel nuts mean?

options.text: The nuts need to be replaced.
The nuts are the wrong size.

questions.explanation: Rust around wheel nuts means they are loose. Check how tight they are if you see rust.

questions.question: When driving through a curve during the skills test, you should:

options.text: Leave your lane if needed to complete the curve.
Slow down after entering the curve.
Stop looking for other vehicles while turning.
Slow down before entering the curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down before entering the curve.
questions.explanation: Before entering a curve, reduce your speed enough so you don't need to brake or shift while in the curve. Keep your vehicle in its lane and watch for traffic.

questions.question: When you apply the brakes, the vehicle should:
questions.explanation: If your vehicle pulls to one side while braking, there may be a problem with the brakes.

questions.question: If you think a road might be icing up, you can:

options.text: Open the window and feel the front of your mirror for ice.

questions.correctAnswerText: Open the window and feel the front of your mirror for ice.
questions.explanation: Open your window and feel the front of your side mirror, mirror support, or antenna. If ice has formed on them, the road is likely becoming icy too.

questions.question: During the vehicle inspection test, you will:

options.text: Explain what you know about the inspection process.
Watch someone else check your vehicle.
Watch a film about vehicle inspection.
Change all the tires on your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Explain what you know about the inspection process.
questions.explanation: You will do a complete inspection of your vehicle. You must explain what you are checking and why.
